status: P1 laboratory profile. Characteristic properties, permissions, CCCD and wire format are NOT frozen (P2-04).

ownService.p1Exposure: Watch 0.6.0-lab exposes the three reserved characteristics as proposed in contracts/proposals/p2-channel-draft.md section 1 (Capabilities READ encrypted, Requests WRITE encrypted, Events NOTIFY with encrypted CCCD). Candidate, NOT FROZEN.
ownService.roleUnderTest: A: watch peripheral/GATT server for the own service, iPhone central. Watch is also ANCS GATT client.

advertising.localNameStatus: Apple proposal for AccessorySetupKit name filtering. Windows P1 lab app puts the system Bluetooth name in the scan response; the operator may set it to 'WristBridge' from the watch diagnostics (reversible). Pending joint confirmation in ADR-001.

ancs.consumer: Kotlin watch only. Swift does not parse or relay ANCS.

productLimits.note: Product limits from the plan, not official ANCS maximums.
